_readme: Relevance eval set for tools/search-eval.html. Each case is [query, expected, group], where expected is a card id or an array of equally-acceptable ids (many questions have two genuinely correct answers). Groups: name = the card called by its name or a close alias; jargon = contest shorthand; paraphrase = plain English describing the idea without using the card's own vocabulary; concept = asked via the quantities in the formula rather than its name; hard = known-difficult phrasings. Add a case whenever a query is reported as ranking badly, BEFORE changing the scorer.
